name: Doubt ~Celeb wa Karei ni Uso o Tsuku~
original_name: ダウト～セレブは華麗に嘘をつく～
source: You're living a successful life as the student of a prestigious university. However, suddenly, your parents start looking for a man to engage you with! You have time from your third year to your graduation to find a lover who fits their tastes to avoid being matchmaked. What lies do these celebrities hide?
